segments.title: Inside the former Kure Naval Station commander's residence
segments.summary: An on-location look at Irifuneyama Memorial Museum, the former official residence of the commander-in-chief at Kure Naval Station.
segments.body: Irifuneyama Memorial Museum occupies the former official residence of the commander-in-chief of Kure Naval Station. The house hosted many visitors and important conversations, some of them at moments of decision. Walking through the rooms gives the naval station's senior command a physical setting. The comparison with British historic houses focuses on the sense of accumulated history inside the building. This visit follows a stop at the Yamato Museum annex during a day devoted to Kure's museums.

evidence.note: Clarke identifies Irifuneyama as the former commander-in-chief's residence at Kure Naval Station and outlines the day's museum visits.
